title: Digital PWM Generator (C++ C-block)
description: Minimal digital PWM generator implemented as a QSpice C++ C-block (DPWM): a sampled duty-cycle input produces a switching gate waveform. The building block behind Alonso's digital-control converter demos.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.video: QSpice for power electronics -- digital PWM in C++
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: digital_pwm_cblock.qsch is Alonso's schematic and dpwm.cpp his C-block source. digital_pwm_cblock.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist; it references the DPWM device, so build dpwm.cpp into dpwm.dll (matching name) before simulating.

workflows.title: Digital PWM Generator (C++ C-block) -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files, build the C-block DLL, then simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
